tasks.subject: Task 1: The battery module and its tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A script that turns sysfs into waybar JSON, with a test suite covering every boundary the spec names.

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/waybar/battery.sh`
- Create: `scripts/waybar/test-battery.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Peripheral at 76% silent, exit 0
- 24% -> low, 9% -> critical, exactly 25% -> silent, exactly 10% -> low
- ONLINE=0 peripheral ignored at every capacity and absent from the tooltip
- System battery always in text, including 100%
- System battery with no ONLINE attribute not skipped
- System 8% Charging -> ok; 8% Discharging -> critical
- Both kinds present: system first, then low peripheral
- Non-numeric CAPACITY skipped with no stderr
- Model containing & escaped as & in the tooltip
- shellcheck -S warning clean on both files

**Verify:** `./scripts/waybar/test-battery.sh` -> final line ends `0 failed`, exit 0

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/waybar/battery.sh", "scripts/waybar/test-battery.sh"], "verifyCommand": "./scripts/waybar/test-battery.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["test suite exits 0 with 0 failures", "peripheral below 25 shows, at/above 25 hides", "ONLINE=0 peripheral ignored at every capacity", "system battery always in text regardless of level", "charging system battery never yields an alert class", "ampersand in model name escaped in tooltip", "shellcheck -S warning clean on both files"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Wire it into the bar
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `custom/battery` renders in waybar with correct colours and spacing, and the built-in `battery` module is gone.

**Files:**
- Modify: `waybar/config.jsonc` — modules-right array, `"battery"` block at ~line 225
- Modify: `waybar/style.css` — header map ~28, grouped selectors ~88/~121/~145, self-contained group ~157, battery section ~263

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- No `"battery"` left in config.jsonc
- No `#battery` left in style.css
- waybar starts with no `No batteries.` warning and no CSS parse error
- #bluetooth and #custom-battery both self-contained at 15px each side
- Header group map reads `... | net | bt | [bat] | vol | ...`
- Forced-visible screenshot shows every OTHER module unmoved

**Verify:** `killall waybar; setsid waybar > /tmp/wb.log 2>&1 & sleep 3; grep -iE "batter|error|css" /tmp/wb.log` -> no battery warning, no CSS error

```json:metadata
{"files": ["waybar/config.jsonc", "waybar/style.css"], "verifyCommand": "killall waybar; sleep 1; setsid waybar > /tmp/wb.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & sleep 3; grep -iE 'batter|error|css' /tmp/wb.log", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no '\"battery\"' left in config.jsonc", "no '#battery' left in style.css", "waybar log free of 'No batteries.' and CSS errors", "bluetooth and custom-battery both self-contained at 15px", "other modules do not move when the battery module appears"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Delete the other two dead surfaces
tasks.description:
**Goal:** swaync stops configuring a backlight it cannot find, and the two brightness keybinds stop pretending.

**Files:**
- Modify: `swaync/config.json` — widgets array (~39), widget-config.backlight (~56)
- Modify: `hypr/config/software/keybinds.conf:144-145`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- No backlight reference left in swaync/config.json
- `jq .` still parses swaync/config.json
- Sidebar screenshot identical to the before-shot
- No XF86MonBrightness binds left
- Cheatsheet no longer lists the brightness rows (no edit to rofi/)

**Verify:** `jq -e '.widgets | index("backlight") == null' swaync/config.json && ! grep -q XF86MonBrightness hypr/config/software/keybinds.conf && echo OK`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["swaync/config.json", "hypr/config/software/keybinds.conf"], "verifyCommand": "jq -e '.widgets | index(\"backlight\") == null' swaync/config.json && ! grep -q XF86MonBrightness hypr/config/software/keybinds.conf && echo OK", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no backlight reference left in swaync/config.json", "swaync/config.json still parses as JSON", "sidebar screenshot unchanged versus before-shot", "no XF86MonBrightness binds left", "cheatsheet no longer lists the brightness rows"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Document it, and verify every surface
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The change is recorded where the repo records changes, and every surface it touched has been looked at.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
- Modify: `CHANGELOG.md` — new dated section at the top
- Modify: `CLAUDE.md` — the scripts/ bullet list

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- test-battery.sh exits 0 with 0 failures
- doctor.sh exits 0 with no new ERROR or WARN findings
- shellcheck -S warning clean on both new scripts
- waybar log free of `No batteries.` and CSS errors
- Bar screenshot captured AND read, other modules confirmed unmoved
- swaync screenshot captured AND read, compared to the before-shot
- CHANGELOG has a `## [2026-08-01]` section
- CLAUDE.md documents battery.sh and the SCOPE-selects-behaviour rule

**Verify:** `./scripts/waybar/test-battery.sh && ./doctor.sh && shellcheck -S warning scripts/waybar/battery.sh scripts/waybar/test-battery.sh && echo ALL GREEN`
